nodes.label: Control Center
nodes.meaning: Human strategy, dispatch, run, recovery, and result surface.

nodes.label: Worker API
nodes.meaning: Checked boundary for worker polling, begins, receipts, and proposed events.

nodes.label: Run API
nodes.meaning: Checked boundary for run registration, reads, and control proposals.

nodes.label: Durable Run Controller
nodes.meaning: Validates run operations and coordinates atomic structural acceptance.

nodes.label: RWO Core
nodes.meaning: Pure Work compiler and structural transition engine.

nodes.label: Accepted-History Port
nodes.meaning: Sole atomic writer for event, next cursor, and complete command batch.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.meaning: Selects pending commands under capacity and capability constraints.

nodes.label: Coordination Store
nodes.meaning: Persists attempts, leases, fences, cancellation, and receipt state.

nodes.label: Artifact Store
nodes.meaning: Stores immutable output bytes addressed by references.

nodes.label: Recovery Projector
nodes.meaning: Derives safe recovery assessments from durable records.

nodes.label: Capability Adapter
nodes.meaning: Connects commands to local, Gateway, model, tool, or human executors.

nodes.label: Agent Worker
nodes.meaning: Executes reasoning turns and returns receipts and event proposals.

nodes.label: Current-State Projector
nodes.meaning: Builds provenance-bearing views from authoritative stores.

nodes.label: Strategy Compiler
nodes.meaning: Validates and compiles authored strategies and templates into Work graphs and bundles.

nodes.label: ARE Adapter
nodes.meaning: Invokes ARE as a bounded reasoning or policy capability without scheduler ownership.

relations.meaning: The UI uses the supported runtime API.
Run operations cross the controller boundary.
Worker operations cross the same controller boundary.
The controller supplies accepted facts and current cursor.
Only this port advances structural history.
The controller owns attempt and lease state.
Lifecycle records remain separate from structural history.
Dispatch remains within configured bounds.
Assignments receive attempts, leases, and fences.
Adapters execute without changing structural meaning.
An Agent is one supported executor kind.
Agents return typed receipts and Event Proposals.
Bulk outputs remain outside structural events.
Recovery starts from accepted history.
Recovery correlates leases, begins, and receipts.
The read model cites the accepted structural revision.
The view keeps lifecycle stages distinct.
The Control Center renders one read model.
Compilation uses the public pure RWO API.
ARE is an adapter capability, not the orchestration loop.

invariants: agents return proposals and receipts; they do not mutate the graph
runtime state, lifecycle state, artifacts, and read projections remain distinct
adapters preserve command and event contracts
claim_ceiling: Candidate system-design projection only; implementation and tests must establish conformance.
